text:
Samir: heads up — prep for Tue demo in APAC. Can we confirm available GPU quota in asia-southeast1 and eu-west1 for the dedicated pools? Need ~40 A100-like slots for 4 hours. @procurement @Maya
Maya: quick check — asia-southeast1 currently shows ~28 A100-equivalent slots free (after reservations). eu-west1 has ~12 free. Not enough for 40.
Devon: options: 1) shift some traffic to eu-west (higher latency), 2) borrow from demo pool (can free ~16), 3) burst to vendor-X (needs procurement approval).
procurement: vendor-X order is still pending (ETA EOD today) — not a firm guarantee. If you want demo-borrow, file the request in the demo-swap PR and cc procurement.
Alex: PR for demo-borrow/terraform is up: https://git.company/repo/pr/1234 — needs one review. @Priya can you take a quick look?
Priya: can do in ~30m. which SKU are we targeting exactly (A100-40GB vs H100)? need that to check IAM/quotas.
Samir: prefer A100-40GB. fallback to H100 is acceptable but costy. With demo-borrow + eu-west overflow we get ~44 total (just over target).
Maya: for an exact check run: `gcloud compute regions describe asia-southeast1 --project=redwood-infra --format=json | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric=="GPUS")'` — I ran this and the counts match (~28 free).
procurement: pre-approved demo-borrow up to 20 GPUs for this event. Please include request id `DB-2026-72` in the PR and the ops runbook.
Devon: I'll bump the autoscaler min by +10 during the window (09:00-13:00 PST) and add rollback steps. Creating a short runbook and tagging DRI.
oncall-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary push to eu-west at 08:45 — no manual action required unless you see failures.
Alex: updated the PR and added `DB-2026-72` in the description. @Priya ping when review is done and I'll merge.
Priya: reviewed, left one nit on var naming (`demo_gpu_count` -> `demo_gpu_slot_count`). will approve after rename.
Samir: thanks team. I'll coordinate a smoke run Monday morning and confirm final numbers. If vendor-X confirms earlier we can re-evaluate. :thumbsup:
